Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the information found on the Brooklyn College/CUNY website. The website explicitly states that Brooklyn College is part of the "City University of New York (CUNY)" system. However, the Planner concluded that it was part of the "State University of New York (SUNY)". This is a factual error regarding the parent organization of Brooklyn College. The Planner likely confused CUNY (City University) with SUNY (State University), leading to the wrong final answer.
